requirements.text: Current system and domain pages cite existing TypeScript sources; historical decisions retain their records.
Each existing documentation category has a disposition; current knowledge is reachable through wiki navigation.
Each of the four previously completed packs has a wiki initiative page and dated retrospective with source revision and hash.
Retrospectives distinguish intent, recorded outcomes, problems, inferred lessons, follow-ups, and unknown feedback.
Documentation audit, wiki ritual, and repository gates run; exact failures and limitations remain disclosed; read-only review is recorded.
The maintenance lifecycle remains draft and its normative proposal stays pending in the findings ledger.
An admitted JSON pack carries the machine plan and actual evidence; SDD skill handoffs register and use that pack on Pi and Codex.

Supersede the retrospective portion of FR-3 and FR-4: withdraw the four historical retrospective interpretations, preserve rejected artifacts outside the wiki, and retain factual initiative snapshots.
Record the rejected two-location research arrangement and the unresolved replacement consolidation design; do not claim physical consolidation complete.
